name: New voter registration (Form 6)
description: Apply to have your name included in the electoral roll of the constituency where you ordinarily reside; the Voter ID (EPIC) is delivered to the given address after enrolment.
description_hi: जहाँ आप सामान्य रूप से रहते हैं, उस निर्वाचन क्षेत्र की मतदाता सूची में नाम जुड़वाने के लिए आवेदन करें; पंजीकरण के बाद मतदाता पहचान पत्र (EPIC) दिए गए पते पर भेजा जाता है।
verification_notes: Based on the ECI Form 6 and its guidelines. Eligibility (age, citizenship) is a declaration in the form and is not modelled. Form 6 accepts 'any other' age or residence document when none of the listed ones is available (with personal verification or field verification); only the listed documents are modelled. 'Certificates of Class X or Class XII' is mapped to the matriculation certificate only. Already enrolled and moving? Use Form 8 instead. Its output is modelled as its own document (a newly issued EPIC) so that GovPath never routes another service's address proof through a new registration: that would presume you are not enrolled, and Form 6 needs the same kind of residence proof anyway. Once you receive the EPIC, mark 'Voter ID (EPIC) showing current address' in your documents.

requirements.name: Recent passport-size colour photograph
requirements.name_hi: हाल का पासपोर्ट आकार का रंगीन फ़ोटो
requirements.notes: Unsigned, 4.5 cm x 3.5 cm, white background.

requirements.name: Proof of date of birth (any one)
requirements.notes: If none of the listed documents is available, another document can be attached and you will have to appear before the Electoral Registration Officer for verification.

options.notes: Class X or XII certificate, if it contains the date of birth.

requirements.name: Proof of ordinary residence (any one)
requirements.notes: May be in the name of the applicant, a parent or spouse. If none of the listed documents is available, field verification is done.

options.notes: At least 1 year old connection at that address.
Current passbook of a nationalised/scheduled bank or post office.

requirements.name: Aadhaar number (for authentication)
requirements.notes: If you don't have an Aadhaar number, you can say so in the form.
